stemMd: Every manuscript accepted by a journal is externally reviewed. No externally reviewed manuscript is anonymous to the editor. Manuscript Linden was accepted. Which conclusion follows?

options.label: A
options.textMd: External reviewers necessarily know Linden’s authorship.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Every manuscript whose authorship is known is accepted.

options.label: E
options.textMd: All rejected manuscripts are anonymous to the editor.

explanationMd: Acceptance entails external review, which excludes anonymity to the editor. The chained implication concerns the editor only.

distractorRationale.a: Knowledge by the editor does not establish knowledge by reviewers.
